target_customer: UK households booking a private chef for dinner parties at home, plus freelance chefs on the supply side
problem: Booking a private chef was expensive and slow through agencies; yhangry offers a priced per-person menu bookable online and gives chefs more earnings than restaurant work.
business_model: Marketplace take rate on chef bookings

founders.name: Heinin Zhang
education: London School of Economics, Philosophy and Economics
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page. Grew up in Germany and China.

founders.name: Siddhi Mittal
prior_employers: Credit trading (six plus years, employer not named)
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page. Grew up in India.

competitors.name: La Belle Assiette
competitors.what: Established private chef at-home booking agency

competitors.name: Dineindulge
competitors.what: Private chef booking agency on request-and-confirm basis

competitors.name: 100 Pleats
competitors.what: Personal chef service named as a similar Uber-for-chefs

technical_complexity.rationale: A two-sided booking marketplace with chef vetting and menus; standard web engineering, with the work being supply quality and operations.

defensibility.rationale: Chef supply and reviews build some local liquidity, but rival agencies and marketplaces offered the same service and chefs multi-home.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found showing an incumbent acquiring or copying yhangry; it remained independent through 2025.

market_need_then: Post-pandemic demand for restaurant-quality dining at home in London and a pool of chefs and restaurant workers seeking higher earnings, per 2021 seed coverage describing 130 chefs in the network.

branding.domain_note: Uses yhangry.com, exact .com; no purchase story found.

identity.logo: Stylised wordmark in all caps in some press (YHANGRY)
identity.voice_and_tone: Playful, built on the word hangry

branding.brand_signature: A play on hangry (hungry and angry) as the name and the shouty brand voice
branding.community_and_virality: Early seed round included a Made in Chelsea cast member as angel, and TechCrunch described the brand as appropriately shouty. Founder interviews appeared in several outlets; no evidence of merch.

brand_strength.rationale: Memorable pun name and playful voice noted by press, but the spelling is nonstandard and no evidence of brand-driven growth was found.

outcome_analysis: yhangry raised a $1.5M angel seed in April 2021 and joined YC in Winter 2022. It remains active with a team of about 12 per the YC directory. A later Series A of 4M reported by an aggregator in February 2025 is unverified. The company has stayed small relative to the marketplace thesis, and funding transparency is limited, so its trajectory is unclear.
notes: Company website returned 403 on fetch. UK Tech News reports the seed as 1.1M pounds, consistent with the $1.5M figure. Signalbase (single aggregator) reports a 4M Series A published 2025-02-13 with confidential investors; currency unclear and not corroborated, so not recorded as a round. CB Insights shows a 0.5M convertible note in January 2022 and VCBacked an equity crowdfunding round in December 2024; both are single aggregator entries and unverified. Founding year conflicts (YC 2020, Bouncewatch 2019). No shutdown or sale news found.
